Virtues: Conviction and Instinct

The Path of Night sums up the Lasombra Antediluvian's legacy in a few brief imperatives: domination, mastery of the darkness, and transcendence over fleshly limitations. Followers — sometimes called Nihilists or simply Night-walkers — treat the world's true nature as darkness and emptiness, and strive to embody that void ever more completely, casting off the last vestiges of a human conscience. The standard form of the Path described here is sometimes called the "Hot Path" to distinguish it from its several known variants (see Path of Night: Variants (Lasombra) for the Cold, Allied, Lightless, and Righteous Paths, each of which shares this Hierarchy of Sins but reinterprets it or substitutes different Virtues).

Hierarchy of Sin (most to least severe):

  1. Failing to conceive an innovative or artistic method of destruction when the opportunity arises
  2. Showing fear in the face of destruction, one's own or another's
  3. Accidentally killing when a more deliberate act would have served instead
  4. Failing to demonstrate mastery of the darkness (Obtenebration or comparable power) when it would be safe and useful to do so

Typical followers: Lasombra, particularly those given over wholly to the Sabbat's Sword of Caine ideology; favors Dominate, Obtenebration, Potence.

vtmlarp.source: Vampire: The Masquerade, Revised Edition / Clanbook: Lasombra
